stages.summary: Build ALM training windows from audio segments, filtered by rate/bandwidth/speaker-count/duration.
Filter overlapping ALM windows, keeping those closest to the target duration.
Complete audio filtering/curation pipeline (CompositeStage) driven by a config.
Aggregate AudioTasks into a DocumentBatch DataFrame, stripping tensors/audio blobs.
Classify audio as full_band vs narrow_band (spectral RF) and filter/annotate.
Estimate effective audio bandwidth from the power spectrum; write to metrics.
Convert Traditional Chinese to Simplified (or other OpenCC conversions), per segment.
Compute WER/CER (plus edge-CER and optional PNC WER/CER) between hypothesis and reference text.
Download the FLEURS dataset and emit one AudioTask per transcript line.
Download the DNS Challenge 5 Read Speech set and emit one AudioTask per file.
Compute audio duration from the file and store it under duration_key.
Compute pairwise WER (%) between reference text and ASR pred_text.
Batched ASR transcription with a NeMo model; writes pred_text.
Speaker diarization (who spoke when) with NVIDIA Sortformer; passthrough or fan-out.
Inverse text normalization: spoken form -> written form (e.g. 'forty two' -> '42').
Rejoin transcripts/alignments of previously split audio back into the original file's metadata.

contract.description: Audio mono conversion and sample rate verification stage.

params.name: output_sample_rate
params.description: Expected sample rate in Hz (default: 48000)

params.name: audio_filepath_key
params.description: Key in data dict for audio file path

params.name: waveform_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the in-memory mono waveform tensor.

params.name: sample_rate_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the waveform sample rate.

params.name: is_mono_key
params.description: Key where the mono flag is written.

params.name: duration_key
params.description: Key where the audio duration in seconds is written.

params.name: num_samples_key
params.description: Key where the number of samples is written.

params.name: output_audio_filepath_key
params.description: Key where the written mono WAV path is stored (write_to_disk=True only).

params.name: original_audio_filepath_key
params.description: Key preserving the pre-conversion path when update_audio_filepath=True.

params.name: strict_sample_rate
params.description: If True, reject audio with wrong sample rate

params.name: input_residency
params.description: Which input to use — "waveform" (in-memory only), "file" (audio_filepath only), or "auto" (waveform first, file fallback; default).

params.name: keep_waveform_in_task
params.description: If True (default), store the mono waveform and sample rate in task.data for downstream in-memory consumers.

params.name: write_to_disk
params.description: If True, write the converted mono audio to a WAV file. write_to_disk without output_dir writes WAV files to the system temp dir and nothing cleans them up; in multi-node runs point output_dir at a shared filesystem.

params.description: If True (with write_to_disk), repoint audio_filepath_key at the written mono WAV and keep the old path under original_audio_filepath_key.

params.description: If True, return one task with all segment dicts under segments_key instead of fanning out one task per segment (default False).

params.name: input_residency

params.description: If True (default), store each segment's waveform in the segment item. If False, nested segments are metadata-only — waveform consumers such as SegmentConcatenation will skip them.

card.summary: Predict UTMOS mean-opinion-score (MOS) and filter/annotate audio by quality.

resource.throughput_hint: fast on GPU; CPU fallback is slower

good_for: gate speech clips by overall perceptual quality
TTS/ASR data curation

params_of_note.mos_threshold: minimum MOS to keep (0-5). TTS: >=4.0; ASR/general: >=3.4; max retention: >=2.5
params_of_note.action: 'filter' drops below threshold; 'annotate' keeps all and only writes the score

comparison.accuracy_hint: single overall MOS predictor; coarser than SIGMOS's 7 dimensions
comparison.known_limitations: predictor of human MOS, not a ground-truth measurement; speech-only

caveats: Downloads the model from torch.hub on first run (needs network once).
Score is a predictor of human MOS, not a ground-truth measurement.

params.name: mos_threshold
params.description: Minimum MOS score to pass (None to disable)

params.name: sample_rate
params.description: Target sample rate for UTMOS inference (default 16000)

params.name: input_residency
params.description: Which input to use — "waveform" (in-memory only), "file" (audio_filepath only), or "auto" (waveform first, file fallback; default).

params.name: mode
params.description: Where to score — "task" (top-level audio), "segments" (nested segments list), or "auto" (segments when segments_key is present, else task; default). Setting "task" or "segments" overrides the auto-detection.

params.name: action
params.description: "filter" drops items below mos_threshold; "annotate" keeps every item — including items that fail or cannot be scored — and only writes score_key.

params.name: audio_filepath_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the input audio file path.

params.name: waveform_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the in-memory waveform tensor.

params.name: sample_rate_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the waveform sample rate.

params.name: segments_key
params.description: Key in data dict holding the nested segments list (segments/auto mode).

params.name: score_key
params.description: Key where the UTMOS MOS score is written.

data_assumptions.input: folder of WAV (48kHz, mono or stereo)

matched_blueprints.produces: JSONL manifest with per-item quality scores + timestamps

stages.why_here: source: scans the folder and produces audio_filepath
normalize to mono + one SR once, upfront (downstream models assume mono)
segment speech so scores are per-segment; this is a granularity choice, not a data dependency
cheapest filter (CPU) first; cull low-fidelity before GPU work
MOS gate
7-dim gate; MOST aggressive -- last = cheap->expensive, first = max early cull (validator does not constrain this order)
sink; TimestampMapper upstream already stripped non-serializable keys

all filters at default ~= 23% pass rate; SIGMOS dominates the drop

filters segments by bandwidth/SR/speaker-count and builds sliding windows; drops words/segments to shrink rows
removes windows overlapping beyond a threshold; run after windows exist
sink

pitfalls: input must already carry per-segment metadata (speaker/start/end); this blueprint does not diarize
CPU-only and fixture-fast -- a good local smoke test

matched_blueprints.intent: transcribe a dataset and drop low-accuracy rows by WER

data_assumptions.input: manifest or dataset with reference transcripts

matched_blueprints.produces: JSONL manifest with pred_text + wer, low-WER rows only

stages.why_here: source: downloads FLEURS and produces audio_filepath + reference text
ASR assumes 16 kHz; pick the checkpoint for the data's language (card)
needs text + pred_text -> must follow ASR
annotate duration for downstream filtering/reporting
filter AFTER wer exists; early filter saves the write cost
sink

pitfalls: WER requires reference transcripts in the source AND ASR pred_text; without transcripts, WER is unproducible
match the ASR checkpoint to the data's language (model-card fact)
don't filter before wer is produced

patterns.then: put MonoConversionStage first so downstream models get consistent mono input

patterns.when: a model stage's card lists supported_sample_rates=[16000] and the data has other rates
patterns.then: insert ResampleAudioStage (or MonoConversionStage output_sample_rate=16000) upstream; doing it once avoids each model re-resampling

patterns.when: a tensor/audio-producing stage precedes a JSON/JSONL writer
patterns.then: insert AudioToDocumentStage before the writer (it strips tensors); the validator also flags this as tensor_into_sink

patterns.when: filtering on a metric field (e.g. wer, duration, mos)
patterns.then: place the filter AFTER the stage that produces the metric; filtering early (before convert/write) saves cost

patterns.when: multiple independent quality filters are used
patterns.then: order cheap CPU filters (BandFilter) before expensive GPU filters (UTMOS/SIGMOS). Note: SIGMOS is empirically the most aggressive -- put it first only if you want maximum early cull
requires reference transcripts in the source manifest AND ASR pred_text upstream; if transcripts are absent, WER is unproducible (find_producers('reference_text') is empty)

patterns.when: the user wants per-segment (not whole-file) scores
patterns.then: enable VAD to fan out one row per speech segment; omit VAD for whole-file scores
re-join segments (SegmentConcatenationStage) before diarization; diarization needs a continuous waveform

params.description: Path or list of paths to JSONL manifests (local or cloud).

params.name: files_per_partition
params.description: Number of manifest files per partition. Defaults to 1.

params.name: blocksize
params.description: Target size per partition (e.g., "100MB"). Ignored if files_per_partition is set.

params.name: file_extensions
params.description: File extensions to filter. Defaults to [".jsonl", ".json"].

params.name: storage_options
params.description: Storage options for cloud paths (S3, GCS credentials, endpoints).

card.summary: Append each AudioTask to a JSONL manifest file (final sink).

good_for: writing the final curated manifest as JSONL
avoid_for: writing task data that still holds tensors (place AudioToDocumentStage first)

params_of_note.output_path: path to the output JSONL manifest

notes: Truncates the output once in setup() (driver) so reruns start clean; setup_on_node() only makes the parent dir. In multi-node runs all nodes append to the same path.

contract.description: Append a single AudioTask to a JSONL manifest file.

params.name: output_path
params.description: Destination JSONL path (local or cloud).

card.summary: Aggregate AudioTasks into a DocumentBatch DataFrame, stripping tensors/audio blobs.

batch_size.reason: batch-only stage; process() raises, use process_batch

resource.throughput_hint: CPU; aggregates a batch into one DataFrame

good_for: the sanctioned bridge before a JSON/JSONL writer
making task data serialization-safe
avoid_for: mid-pipeline (place it just before the writer)

notes: Sanitizes output: strips torch tensors / audio arrays / segments, so it is the correct thing to place before a serialize-as-JSON sink when a resident waveform may be present (avoids tensor_into_sink at json.dumps).

contract.description: Convert AudioTask entries into DocumentBatch DataFrames.

card.summary: Convert to mono and (optionally) verify/resample to a target sample rate.

good_for: normalizing stereo/multi-channel input to mono before models
first step of a quality-filter chain
avoid_for: data already mono at the target rate

params_of_note.strict_sample_rate: if True, enforce the target rate

contract.description: Audio mono conversion and sample rate verification stage.

params.name: output_sample_rate
params.description: Expected sample rate in Hz (default: 48000)

params.name: audio_filepath_key
params.description: Key in data dict for audio file path

params.name: waveform_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the in-memory mono waveform tensor.

params.name: sample_rate_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the waveform sample rate.

params.name: is_mono_key
params.description: Key where the mono flag is written.

params.name: duration_key
params.description: Key where the audio duration in seconds is written.

params.name: num_samples_key
params.description: Key where the number of samples is written.

params.name: output_audio_filepath_key
params.description: Key where the written mono WAV path is stored (write_to_disk=True only).

params.name: original_audio_filepath_key
params.description: Key preserving the pre-conversion path when update_audio_filepath=True.

params.name: strict_sample_rate
params.description: If True, reject audio with wrong sample rate

params.name: input_residency
params.description: Which input to use — "waveform" (in-memory only), "file" (audio_filepath only), or "auto" (waveform first, file fallback; default).

params.name: keep_waveform_in_task
params.description: If True (default), store the mono waveform and sample rate in task.data for downstream in-memory consumers.

params.name: write_to_disk
params.description: If True, write the converted mono audio to a WAV file. write_to_disk without output_dir writes WAV files to the system temp dir and nothing cleans them up; in multi-node runs point output_dir at a shared filesystem.

params.name: update_audio_filepath
params.description: If True (with write_to_disk), repoint audio_filepath_key at the written mono WAV and keep the old path under original_audio_filepath_key.

params.name: output_dir
params.description: Directory for the written WAV files (default: system temp dir).

category_tree.description: Create/read manifests and partition input files (dataset sources, manifest readers).
Normalize audio before models: mono conversion and sample-rate resampling.
Cut audio into speech chunks: VAD, long-audio splitting, segment concatenation.
Who-spoke-when and per-speaker separation (Sortformer, PyAnnote, speaker separation).
ASR transcription and forced word-alignment (NeMo ASR).
Text post-processing on transcripts: inverse text normalization, Chinese conversion.
Score/gate audio quality: UTMOS, SIGMOS, SQUIM, bandwidth, band filter.
Generic value-based row filtering (keep/drop by a numeric or string field).
Audio-language-model data building: windowing, overlap filtering, snippet planning.
Convert/aggregate and write results: AudioToDocument, manifest/JSONL writers, timestamp mapping, segment extraction.

card.summary: Silero VAD: detect speech and emit one segment per speech chunk (fan-out or nested).

good_for: removing silence
chunking long audio into utterances
per-segment quality scoring
avoid_for: when you want whole-file scores (skip VAD entirely)

params_of_note.nested: True = one task with all segments under segments_key; False = fan-out one task per segment

comparison.known_limitations: VAD only (no speaker labels); changes granularity to per-segment

contract.description: Stage to segment audio using Voice Activity Detection (VAD).

params.name: min_interval_ms
params.description: Minimum silence interval between speech segments in milliseconds.

params.name: min_duration_sec
params.description: Minimum segment duration in seconds.

params.name: max_duration_sec
params.description: Maximum segment duration in seconds.

params.name: threshold
params.description: Voice activity detection threshold (0.0-1.0).

params.name: speech_pad_ms
params.description: Padding in ms to add before/after speech segments.

params.name: audio_filepath_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the input audio file path.

params.name: waveform_key
params.description: Key to get waveform data.

params.name: sample_rate_key
params.description: Key to get sample rate.

params.name: segments_key
params.description: Key where the nested segments list is written (nested=True).

params.name: start_ms_key
params.description: Key where each segment's start time in milliseconds is written.

params.name: end_ms_key
params.description: Key where each segment's end time in milliseconds is written.

params.name: segment_num_key
params.description: Key where each segment's index is written.

params.name: duration_key
params.description: Key where each segment's duration in seconds is written.

params.name: original_file_key
params.description: Key carrying the source file path for provenance.

params.name: nested
params.description: If True, return one task with all segment dicts under segments_key instead of fanning out one task per segment (default False).

params.name: input_residency
params.description: Which input to use — "waveform" (in-memory only), "file" (audio_filepath only), or "auto" (waveform first, file fallback; default).

params.name: keep_segment_waveform_in_task
params.description: If True (default), store each segment's waveform in the segment item. If False, nested segments are metadata-only — waveform consumers such as SegmentConcatenation will skip them.

card.summary: Predict UTMOS mean-opinion-score (MOS) and filter/annotate audio by quality.

resource.throughput_hint: fast on GPU; CPU fallback is slower

good_for: gate speech clips by overall perceptual quality
TTS/ASR data curation

params_of_note.mos_threshold: minimum MOS to keep (0-5). TTS: >=4.0; ASR/general: >=3.4; max retention: >=2.5
params_of_note.action: 'filter' drops below threshold; 'annotate' keeps all and only writes the score

comparison.accuracy_hint: single overall MOS predictor; coarser than SIGMOS's 7 dimensions
comparison.known_limitations: predictor of human MOS, not a ground-truth measurement; speech-only

caveats: Downloads the model from torch.hub on first run (needs network once).
Score is a predictor of human MOS, not a ground-truth measurement.

params.name: mos_threshold
params.description: Minimum MOS score to pass (None to disable)

params.name: sample_rate
params.description: Target sample rate for UTMOS inference (default 16000)

params.name: input_residency
params.description: Which input to use — "waveform" (in-memory only), "file" (audio_filepath only), or "auto" (waveform first, file fallback; default).

params.name: mode
params.description: Where to score — "task" (top-level audio), "segments" (nested segments list), or "auto" (segments when segments_key is present, else task; default). Setting "task" or "segments" overrides the auto-detection.

params.name: action
params.description: "filter" drops items below mos_threshold; "annotate" keeps every item — including items that fail or cannot be scored — and only writes score_key.

params.name: audio_filepath_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the input audio file path.

params.name: waveform_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the in-memory waveform tensor.

params.name: sample_rate_key
params.description: Key in data dict for the waveform sample rate.

params.name: segments_key
params.description: Key in data dict holding the nested segments list (segments/auto mode).

params.name: score_key
params.description: Key where the UTMOS MOS score is written.

matched_blueprints.intent: curate clean speech from a raw WAV folder by quality; no transcription

data_assumptions.input: folder of WAV (48kHz, mono or stereo)

matched_blueprints.produces: JSONL manifest with per-item quality scores + timestamps

topology_selection.rule: output granularity decides which flags to enable

options.shape: Mono -> VAD(nested) -> Filters -> SegConcat -> SpeakerSep -> VAD -> Filters -> TimestampMapper

stages.why_here: source: scans the folder and produces audio_filepath
normalize to mono + one SR once, upfront (downstream models assume mono)
segment speech so scores are per-segment; this is a granularity choice, not a data dependency
cheapest filter (CPU) first; cull low-fidelity before GPU work
MOS gate
7-dim gate; MOST aggressive -- last = cheap->expensive, first = max early cull (validator does not constrain this order)
sink; TimestampMapper upstream already stripped non-serializable keys

pitfalls: no transcripts here -> cannot add ASR/WER; use the fleurs blueprint for that
all filters at default ~= 23% pass rate; SIGMOS dominates the drop
don't skip resample/mono on 48k stereo data

matched_blueprints.intent: build audio-language-model training windows from a diarized manifest and filter overlaps
matched_blueprints.produces: JSONL manifest of bounded, overlap-filtered training windows

stages.why_here: source: streams the JSONL manifest into AudioTasks
filters segments by bandwidth/SR/speaker-count and builds sliding windows; drops words/segments to shrink rows
removes windows overlapping beyond a threshold; run after windows exist
sink

pitfalls: input must already carry per-segment metadata (speaker/start/end); this blueprint does not diarize
CPU-only and fixture-fast -- a good local smoke test

matched_blueprints.intent: transcribe a dataset and drop low-accuracy rows by WER

data_assumptions.input: manifest or dataset with reference transcripts

matched_blueprints.produces: JSONL manifest with pred_text + wer, low-WER rows only

stages.why_here: source: downloads FLEURS and produces audio_filepath + reference text
ASR assumes 16 kHz; pick the checkpoint for the data's language (card)
needs text + pred_text -> must follow ASR
annotate duration for downstream filtering/reporting
filter AFTER wer exists; early filter saves the write cost
sink

pitfalls: WER requires reference transcripts in the source AND ASR pred_text; without transcripts, WER is unproducible
match the ASR checkpoint to the data's language (model-card fact)
don't filter before wer is produced

patterns.then: put MonoConversionStage first so downstream models get consistent mono input

patterns.when: a model stage's card lists supported_sample_rates=[16000] and the data has other rates
patterns.then: insert ResampleAudioStage (or MonoConversionStage output_sample_rate=16000) upstream; doing it once avoids each model re-resampling

patterns.when: a tensor/audio-producing stage precedes a JSON/JSONL writer
patterns.then: insert AudioToDocumentStage before the writer (it strips tensors); the validator also flags this as tensor_into_sink

patterns.when: filtering on a metric field (e.g. wer, duration, mos)
patterns.then: place the filter AFTER the stage that produces the metric; filtering early (before convert/write) saves cost

patterns.when: multiple independent quality filters are used
patterns.then: order cheap CPU filters (BandFilter) before expensive GPU filters (UTMOS/SIGMOS). Note: SIGMOS is empirically the most aggressive -- put it first only if you want maximum early cull
requires reference transcripts in the source manifest AND ASR pred_text upstream; if transcripts are absent, WER is unproducible (find_producers('reference_text') is empty)

patterns.when: the user wants per-segment (not whole-file) scores
patterns.then: enable VAD to fan out one row per speech segment; omit VAD for whole-file scores
re-join segments (SegmentConcatenationStage) before diarization; diarization needs a continuous waveform
